explication: NAPS2 is a cross-platform document-scanning application and SDK. The main workflow is: a user starts a scan in the desktop UI, the scan controller discovers and reads a scanner, images are stored and organized, optional transforms and OCR are applied, and pages are exported to document or image files. The application also supports direct import, recovery, profiles, email delivery, and sharing a scanner through an eSCL server. Some platform-specific scanner implementations are present only as unsampled areas of the tree.
